title: •I’m With You Too
caption: •I’m With You Too (V)
game_text: Deploy on Luke (even if a captive) or any non-{episode1} Throne Room; recirculate. Your duel destiny draws are +1. Once per turn, may lose 3 Force to cancel a just drawn battle destiny at same or related locations of either Luke or this Effect.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique; curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (I’m), as on the printed title. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Inline black 'EPISODE I' circle after 'non-' → {episode1} (stub: 'non-Episode I'). Errata of 17 Sep 2007: the sheet's text is the final one (stub notes the same). ODD: the slip's bottom strip carries a small round gold/bronze disc between the caption and the number '10' (no other slip in 01–10 has it) — presumably the sheet's errata marker; not transcribed as a field. Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Base scan only 350 px; copyright Death Star II line, 2000 (low-res). Modern: VB3-L-imwithyoutoo-pre.gif (350 px); no V<N> remake.
